boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Texas Tech University
boards.description: Ten currently documented late-hours food stops in Lubbock, including several along the University Avenue and 4th Street approaches to Texas Tech.

cards.title: Whataburger at 9th & University
cards.subtitle: 2412 9th St, Lubbock
cards.notes: Use the dining room for a late meal at the 9th-and-University location. Check the official page before leaving, since holiday operations can differ.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour dining-room option on the University Avenue approach to campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Whataburger lists its dine-in service at 2412 9th St as 24 hours daily.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in as 24 hours every day; drive-thru is listed closed. Holiday hours may differ.

cards.title: IHOP at 1627 University Ave
cards.subtitle: 1627 University Ave, Lubbock
cards.notes: Plan for a sit-down or takeout stop near 19th Street and University Avenue. The location page lists round-the-clock restaurant hours.
cards.short_summary: An all-hours pancake and breakfast stop on University Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP lists the restaurant at 1627 University Ave as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast Restaurants Near You at 1627 University Ave
cards.access_notes: Official page lists restaurant hours as open 24 hours every day and identifies dine-in and takeout amenities.

cards.title: Denny's at 4718 Slide Rd
cards.subtitle: 4718 Slide Rd, Lubbock
cards.notes: Head to Slide Road when you want a full diner menu after normal dinner hours. The official location page says the restaurant is open around the clock.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour diner option with breakfast, lunch, and dinner service.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's lists its restaurant at 4718 Slide Rd as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the restaurant as open 24 hours daily and offers online ordering and walk-ins.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on 4th Street
cards.subtitle: 5702 4th St, Lubbock
cards.notes: Take 4th Street west from the Texas Tech area for dine-in, drive-thru, or curbside service. Confirm the posted hours if visiting around a holiday.
cards.short_summary: A 4th Street chicken-finger restaurant serving until 3 a.m. daily.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's lists both dine-in and drive-thru hours at 5702 4th Street as 10 a.m. to 3 a.m. every day.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru service until 3 a.m. Sunday through Saturday; curbside pickup is available.

cards.title: Raising Cane's on 82nd Street
cards.subtitle: 2725 82nd St, Lubbock
cards.notes: Use this south-Lubbock location when the 4th Street route is not convenient. Its official page separately posts dine-in and drive-thru closing times.
cards.short_summary: A Cane's location with 2 a.m. closes most nights and 3 a.m. weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane's lists 2725 82nd Street open until 2 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists dine-in and drive-thru until 2 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 402 Ave Q
cards.subtitle: 402 Ave Q, Lubbock
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for the late window at this central-Lubbock Taco Bell. Dine-in is listed separately, so rely on the drive-thru schedule after evening hours.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option posted until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 402 Ave Q until 2 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 402 Ave Q, Lubbock
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. most nights and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in is listed closed.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 5713 Fourth Street
cards.subtitle: 5713 Fourth St, Lubbock
cards.notes: Keep this 4th Street drive-thru in mind for an after-hours order west of campus. The official locator identifies this specific Lubbock restaurant as open late.
cards.short_summary: A 4th Street Taco Bell whose official locator lists late-night drive-thru availability.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official Lubbock locator lists the restaurant at 5713 Fourth Street as open until 2 a.m.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell at 5713 Fourth Street, Lubbock
cards.access_notes: Official Taco Bell locator lists the 5713 Fourth Street location as open until 2 a.m.; verify the day-specific drive-thru schedule before travel.

cards.title: Taco Bell at 5010 Milwaukee Ave
cards.subtitle: 5010 Milwaukee Ave, Lubbock
cards.notes: For a west-Lubbock drive-thru stop, use the posted late schedule at Milwaukee Avenue. The dining room closes earlier than the drive-thru.
cards.short_summary: A Milwaukee Avenue drive-thru serving until 1 a.m. weekdays and 2 a.m. weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours at 5010 Milwaukee Ave until 1 a.m. Sunday through Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday and Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell Takeout at 5010 Milwaukee Ave, Lubbock
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.title: McDonald's at 6501 4th Street
cards.subtitle: 6501 4th St, Lubbock
cards.notes: This 4th Street restaurant is another documented all-hours food stop west of Texas Tech. Use the restaurant entrance rather than assuming drive-thru hours match.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour McDonald's restaurant on the westbound 4th Street corridor.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists restaurant and lobby hours at 6501 4th Street as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the restaurant and lobby as open 24 hours daily; it separately lists drive-thru hours ending at 1 a.m.

cards.title: Subway at 1109 University Ave
cards.subtitle: 1109 University Ave, Lubbock
cards.notes: Choose the University Avenue Subway when you need a sandwich close to the campus approach. Confirm the exact storefront details with the official locator before heading out.
cards.short_summary: A University Avenue Subway listed as open 24 hours in the official Lubbock locator.
cards.evidence_claim: Subway's official Lubbock location directory lists the restaurant at 1109 University Ave as open 24 hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official Lubbock directory lists 1109 University Ave as open 24 hours daily; use the locator to confirm current store details.
